titulo: Textron (Nov 2023): $1.168 billion in buybacks, about 725 positions cut. The math.
caption:
Textron (Nov 2023): $1.168 billion in buybacks, about 725 positions cut. The math.

From the archive: Nov 2023. Not today's news.
Textron, Nov 28, 2023 (Textron, Form 8-K (Item 2.05)): "reduce operating expenses through headcount reductions at the Industrial, Bell and Textron Systems segments"
Textron's Form 8-K, filed Nov 28, 2023, says its plan will reduce operating expenses through headcount reductions, approximately 725 positions across the impacted segments, 2% of its global workforce.

Same year: $1.168 billion in buybacks, 2023, company-wide. $1,168 million of share repurchases in 2023, company-wide (MD&A of the 10-K).
The math: $1.168 billion in buybacks (2023) ÷ about 725 job cuts = about $1.6 million in buybacks per position cut.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the total spent on buybacks divided by the job count. The $1.168 billion is Textron's share repurchases in 2023, company-wide, from its 10-K. Textron's dividend ($16 million in 2023) is left out. We are not saying one paid for the other.

A ratio, not a cause. Textron has not linked the buybacks to the cuts.

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Synthetic voice. Sources: SEC EDGAR · Textron, Nov 28, 2023; SEC EDGAR · Textron, Feb 12, 2024.
